billing_accounting_event_links_status_ta.name: billing_accounting_event_links_status_target_check
billing_accounting_event_links_status_ta.value: (`billing_accounting_event_links`.`link_status` = 'linked' AND `billing_accounting_event_links`.`workspace_id` IS NOT NULL AND `billing_accounting_event_links`.`payment_ledger_id` IS NOT NULL) OR (`billing_accounting_event_links`.`link_status` <> 'linked' AND `billing_accounting_event_links`.`payment_ledger_id` IS NULL)

billing_notification_receiver_lease_stat.name: billing_notification_receiver_lease_state
billing_notification_receiver_lease_stat.value: (`billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`status` = 'processing' AND `billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`locked_at` IS NOT NULL AND `billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`lease_token` IS NOT NULL) OR (`billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`status` <> 'processing' AND `billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`locked_at` IS NULL AND `billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`lease_token` IS NULL)

billing_notification_receiver_delivery_s.name: billing_notification_receiver_delivery_state
billing_notification_receiver_delivery_s.value: (`billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`status` = 'delivered' AND `billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`delivered_at` IS NOT NULL) OR (`billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`status` <> 'delivered' AND `billing_notification_receiver_outbox`.`delivered_at` IS NULL)

billing_outbox_delivery_state_status.name: billing_outbox_delivery_state_status
billing_outbox_delivery_state_status.value: (`billing_outbox`.`delivery_state` NOT IN ('preparing','transport_started') OR `billing_outbox`.`status` = 'processing') AND (`billing_outbox`.`delivery_state` <> 'transport_succeeded' OR `billing_outbox`.`status` IN ('processing','completed')) AND (`billing_outbox`.`delivery_state` <> 'ambiguous' OR `billing_outbox`.`status` = 'failed')

billing_provider_operations_started_time.name: billing_provider_operations_started_timestamp
billing_provider_operations_started_time.value: `billing_provider_operations`.`state` NOT IN ('transport_started','ambiguous','succeeded') OR `billing_provider_operations`.`first_started_at` IS NOT NULL

billing_provider_operations_success_resu.name: billing_provider_operations_success_result
billing_provider_operations_success_resu.value: `billing_provider_operations`.`state` <> 'succeeded' OR (`billing_provider_operations`.`provider_resource_id` IS NOT NULL AND `billing_provider_operations`.`completed_at` IS NOT NULL)

billing_scheduler_enabled_audit_required.name: billing_scheduler_enabled_audit_required
billing_scheduler_enabled_audit_required.value: `billing_scheduler_tenants`.`enabled` = false OR `billing_scheduler_tenants`.`kind` = 'outbox' OR (`billing_scheduler_tenants`.`operator_request_id` IS NOT NULL AND `billing_scheduler_tenants`.`operator_request_fingerprint` IS NOT NULL AND `billing_scheduler_tenants`.`enabled_by_user_id` IS NOT NULL AND `billing_scheduler_tenants`.`enabled_at` IS NOT NULL)

billing_scheduler_lease_pair.name: billing_scheduler_lease_pair
billing_scheduler_lease_pair.value: (`billing_scheduler_tenants`.`lease_token` IS NULL AND `billing_scheduler_tenants`.`lease_until` IS NULL) OR (`billing_scheduler_tenants`.`lease_token` IS NOT NULL AND `billing_scheduler_tenants`.`lease_until` IS NOT NULL)

messenger_privacy_subject_erased_timesta.name: messenger_privacy_subject_erased_timestamp
messenger_privacy_subject_erased_timesta.value: (`messenger_privacy_subjects`.`status` = 'erased' AND `messenger_privacy_subjects`.`erased_at` IS NOT NULL) OR (`messenger_privacy_subjects`.`status` <> 'erased' AND `messenger_privacy_subjects`.`erased_at` IS NULL)

messenger_provider_attempt_started_times.name: messenger_provider_attempt_started_timestamp
messenger_provider_attempt_started_times.value: `messenger_provider_attempt_fences`.`status` NOT IN ('started','ambiguous','succeeded') OR `messenger_provider_attempt_fences`.`started_at` IS NOT NULL

workspace_entitlement_reservation_bindin.name: workspace_entitlement_reservation_binding_pair
workspace_entitlement_reservation_bindin.value: (`workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`channel_connection_id` IS NULL AND `workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`binding_epoch` IS NULL) OR (`workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`channel_connection_id` IS NOT NULL AND `workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`binding_epoch` > 0)

workspace_entitlement_reservation_delive.name: workspace_entitlement_reservation_delivery_pair
workspace_entitlement_reservation_delive.value: (`workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`delivery_started_at` IS NULL AND `workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`delivery_attempt_token_hash` IS NULL AND `workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`delivery_known_rejected_at` IS NULL) OR (`workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`delivery_started_at` IS NOT NULL AND `workspace_entitlement_usage_reservations`.`delivery_attempt_token_hash` IS NOT NULL)
